 Croc2: Sailor Village 
 Sailor Village (also known as Oki-Doki ) is the first Village in 
[url= 2. It has a lot of grass, flowers, and beaches surrounding it.

Sailor Village has a lot of sandy beaches, a large river that runs through the village and much greenery and flowers around the area. It is also home to a few dark caves with mine carts.

 About Croc 2: Croc 2 is a platform game developed by Argonaut Games and released in 1999 for the PlayStation and PC. It is a sequel to the game Croc: Legend of the Gobbos , which was released in 1997. Players take on the role of a small green crocodile named Croc, who is on a quest to rescue his friends, the Gobbos, and defeat the evil forces threatening their world.

 THIS MAP TOTAL 4 STAGES 
 STAGE 1: Get the Gobbo's Sandwich!
 STAGE 2: Find the Key! Save the Gobbo!
 STAGE 3: Find 5 Lost Treasure Chests
 STAGE 4: Sailor Tribe Secret Mine
